snippet.title: Is this a Game yet? | You Design I Develop -  Open Beta Results Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Is this a Game yet? on Steam https://store.steampowered.com/app/3831220/Is_this_a_Game_yet/ and join this once in a lifetime game design and development experience on day 1.

Is This a Game Yet? is launching into Early Access on July 10th at 7:00 PM CEST!

I made a Game that's EMPTY inside so YOU Can Design It Yourself.

As a solo developer, I'm building this game live on stream, and YOU get to be a part of the development process every single week. Submit your wildest game design ideas, and the top 3 high scores and top 2 most-liked submissions on the leaderboard will be implemented into the game with every update.

This trailer contains the player design results of the Open Beta Cycles, which you can play for FREE here https://littleneedleinteractive.itch.io/is-this-a-game-yet. Cycle 3 runs until July 7th, 2:00 AM CEST. The Journey starts from scratch for the Steam release, but old Cycles will remain playable in a legacy mode.

#itagy #indiegame #gamedev #indiedev #solodev #vtuber #twitch #onizumikohari
